svg.title: Base-Case Gross Billings to 14.0% Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Base-Case Gross Billings to 14.0% Owner Net; subtitle: $1,400,000 gross revenue less $1,204,000 costs equals $196,000.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Six bars: the first is an opening total, the middle four are signed deductions, and the last is a closing total rather than another additive movement. Cost allocations are illustrative; the canonical revenue, margin, and owner net are fixed. All operating charges are contained in the four expense buckets; owner-level personal taxes are outside this model.; caption: Vendor costs consume 70.0% of gross revenue; delivery, staffing, and overhead consume another 16.0%. The remaining 14.0% is the canonical $196,000 annual owner net profit.; stages: label: Gross revenue; value: $1,400,000 annual license resale and service billings; numeric value: 1400000.0; detail: Opening total includes only the reseller's modeled license and service sales, excluding unrelated customer cloud spend and sales taxes collected for remittance.; label: Vendor acquisition; value: Subtract $980,000; 70.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -980000.0; detail: Illustrative software acquisition and distributor charges leave $420,000 before delivery and operating expenses. Do not count prospective vendor rebates before earned.; label: Contract delivery; value: Subtract $84,000; 6.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -84000.0; detail: Three contractor seats share $84,000 in annual engagement spend for scoped implementation, license reconciliation, and specialist support; seats are not full-time equivalents.; label: Full-time staffing; value: Subtract $98,000; 7.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -98000.0; detail: Two full-time seats share an illustrative loaded annual staffing budget of $98,000. Higher local compensation requires additional contribution or reduces owner net.; label: Operating overhead; value: Subtract $42,000; 3.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -42000.0; detail: Illustrative overhead includes marketplace charges not already in vendor costs, CRM, insurance, professional services, collection losses, and other operating charges.; label: Annual owner net; value: $196,000 retained; exactly 14.0% net margin; numeric value: 196000.0; detail: $1,400,000 minus $980,000 minus $84,000 minus $98,000 minus $42,000 equals $196,000. Non-vendor operating costs average $18,666.67 monthly, within the canonical range.

text.title: Base-Case Gross Billings to 14.0% Owner Net
text.tspan: Base-Case Gross Billings to 14.0% Owner Net

rect.title: label: Gross revenue; value: $1,400,000 annual license resale and service billings; numeric value: 1400000.0; detail: Opening total includes only the reseller's modeled license and service sales, excluding unrelated customer cloud spend and sales taxes collected for remittance.

label: Vendor acquisition; value: Subtract $980,000; 70.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -980000.0; detail: Illustrative software acquisition and distributor charges leave $420,000 before delivery and operating expenses. Do not count prospective vendor rebates before earned.

label: Contract delivery; value: Subtract $84,000; 6.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -84000.0; detail: Three contractor seats share $84,000 in annual engagement spend for scoped implementation, license reconciliation, and specialist support; seats are not full-time equivalents.

label: Full-time staffing; value: Subtract $98,000; 7.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -98000.0; detail: Two full-time seats share an illustrative loaded annual staffing budget of $98,000. Higher local compensation requires additional contribution or reduces owner net.

label: Operating overhead; value: Subtract $42,000; 3.0% of gross revenue; numeric value: -42000.0; detail: Illustrative overhead includes marketplace charges not already in vendor costs, CRM, insurance, professional services, collection losses, and other operating charges.

label: Annual owner net; value: $196,000 retained; exactly 14.0% net margin; numeric value: 196000.0; detail: $1,400,000 minus $980,000 minus $84,000 minus $98,000 minus $42,000 equals $196,000. Non-vendor operating costs average $18,666.67 monthly, within the canonical range.

text.title: Assumptions: Six bars: the first is an opening total, the middle four are signed deductions, and the last is a closing total rather than another additive movement. Cost allocations are illustrative; the canonical revenue, margin, and owner net are fixed. All operating charges are contained in the four expense buckets; owner-level personal taxes are outside this model.
